text:
liam_sales: Quick ask from EdgeScale (HW partner)  marketplace intake wants a compact compliance bundle but with extra hardware bits: SOC excerpt, pen attestation, and a firmware attestation chain (hashes + signer). They specifically requested a GPG-signed manifest of firmware hashes and a notarized chain-of-custody note.

anya_security: That's doable but we need to be careful about what we publish. Firmware hashes + signed manifest OK. Full firmware blobs are not provided. Chain-of-custody should be a short notarized text confirming timestamped custody transitions for the firmware image used in the SI test. Redact internal hostnames/IPs.

oscar_partnerships: Deadline from their legal: Monday noon. They want an Azure marketplace ingest link (SAS) with TTL 48h and a small manifest (YAML or JSON) listing artifacts, TTL, owner, and redaction status. Also they prefer the firmware manifest be GPG-signed by the hardware vendor.

hw_vendor_lead: We can produce a GPG-signed firmware_manifest.json that lists images and sha256 sums, plus our vendor signature block. We'll also provide a notarized custody letter (PDF) that our legal team can sign.

anya_security: Good. Redaction rules: SOC excerpt: auditor name + control headings only. Pen attestation: one-page vendor-signed summary with vendor name and date; no exploit details. For firmware manifest: include sha256 for each artifact and the GPG signature file (firmware_manifest.json.sig). Don't include kernel symbols or debug artifacts.

liam_sales: Can you confirm the exact manifest format they accept? I think they said JSON with fields: artifacts[], owner, ttl_hours, redaction_status, signature_file.

oscar_partnerships: Confirmed. They prefer JSON. Sample they will ingest: 
```
{
  "artifact_name": "edgescale_evidence_bundle.tar.gz",
  "artifacts": ["soc_excerpt_redacted.pdf","pen_attestation_vendor.pdf","firmware_manifest.json","firmware_manifest.json.sig","chain_of_custody_notarized.pdf","README_marketplace.txt"],
  "owner": "oscar_partnerships",
  "ttl_hours": "48",
  "redaction_status": "IPs/hostnames/PII removed",
  "signature_file": "firmware_manifest.json.sig"
}
```

entity_bot: [automated] Evidence policy reminder: external SAS/SAS-like links default TTL <= 72 hours. All artifacts require an owner and taxonomy tag `marketplace-evidence/hw-v1`. Escalate to compliance@redwood.com for TTL > 90 days.

hw_vendor_lead: We'll produce firmware_manifest.json with entries like: {"image":"edge-fw-v1.4.2.bin", "sha256":"abc123...", "build_date":"2025-06-01"} and sign with our vendor GPG key; we will attach firmware_manifest.json.sig. We can notarize chain_of_custody_notarized.pdf as requested.

anya_security: Please include a short line in README_marketplace.txt about verification: how to verify the GPG signature and SHA256 sums, and contact security@redwood.com for disputes. Also include the public GPG key fingerprint for vendor and a sha256 for the notarization PDF.

liam_sales: For Azure SAS we OK? We usually do S3 presigns but partner prefers Azure. Oscar, can you create an SAS with 48h TTL and tag objects with `marketplace-evidence/hw-v1` and owner metadata?

oscar_partnerships: Yes, I'll generate an Azure SAS and attach metadata in the manifest. I'll include a small README that explains redaction and how to request longer retention.

entity_bot: [automated] Label reminder: include `marketplace-evidence/hw-v1` taxonomy on object metadata and a manifest at the tarball root. Owner metadata must be resolvable to a Redwood person.

hw_vendor_lead: Quick note on the firmwares we list: we will only list public build versions used in SI testing; no internal test builds. We'll provide sha256 and build dates. GPG fingerprint: `4B1A 9C2D 0F7E 1234 9F8B 6E55 1A2B 3C4D 5E6F 7A88` (vendor pubkey id).

anya_security: Also add an explicit KMS statement for artifact at-rest encryption: short paragraph confirming HSM-backed CMKs used and no key export to partners. We'll include it as kms_statement.txt inside bundle.

liam_sales: Action items: (1) hw_vendor_lead produce firmware_manifest.json + firmware_manifest.json.sig and public key fingerprint, (2) anya_security prepare redacted SOC excerpt + pen attestation and kms_statement.txt, (3) oscar_partnerships assemble bundle, compute SHA256s, create Azure SAS TTL=48h, and publish manifest.json as root entry. Target: publish by 2025-10-06 11:59 PT.

oscar_partnerships: I'll add checksums in manifest and include verification steps in README. Will DM SAS links once live.

hw_vendor_lead: We'll also provide a one-line vendor attestation: `TrustAssure performed a vendor-scoped pen-test on 2025-07-15; no critical findings.` that will go into pen_attestation_vendor.pdf (redacted).

anya_security: I'll double-check redaction and add the required taxonomy tags. If compliance needs notarization of chain_of_custody, escalate to compliance@redwood.com.

oscar_partnerships: Thanks all. I'll ping when SAS presigns live. :white_check_mark:
